title: Report every step of a partially applied SDDC LCM fleet change
prompt:
Implement the standard-library-only Go package in the single file `fleetlcm/plan.go`. Do not add dependencies and do not edit any other file.

The protected `docs/contract.json` is a focused projection derived directly from `specifications/sddc-lcm/sddc-lcm-openapi.yaml` in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository at immutable VCF 9.1 release-readiness commit `3949fc33339fc5ea1b77eadb258f1cf49aa88e26`. `docs/official_sources.json` records the exact specification path, the repository commit SHA, and a separate specification source record for every operationId. No rendered documentation page is a contract source. Use exactly the specification operationIds `setDepot`, `resolveDepotComponents`, `createComponents`, `getTask` and `updateComponentConfig`; do not call another route.

Preserve the supplied exported API and its doc comments: `Config`, `NewClient`, `Client`, `Client.Apply`, `Plan`, `DepotSpec`, `ComponentPin`, `ComponentPlan`, `NodePlan`, `IPv4Settings`, `IPv6Settings`, `ConfigPlan`, `NodeSizePlan`, `PlanReport`, `PlanReport.Step`, `StepReport`, `ResolvedVersion`, `StepError`, `PlanOperations`, `ServiceBasePath`, the `Op*` operationId constants and the `Status*` constants. The `ErrNotImplemented` scaffolding sentinel may be deleted once nothing returns it.

`NewClient` must reject a configuration before anything is sent. `Config.BaseURL` must be an absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL with a host and no userinfo, non-root path, query or fragment; a bare trailing slash is acceptable. Reject a blank `Config.Token`, and reject a token or a non-empty `Config.CorrelationID` that contains an ASCII control character. Default `PollInterval` to 2s, `PollTimeout` to 30m and `HTTPClient` to a client with a 30s timeout.

Every request target is `Config.BaseURL`, then `ServiceBasePath` (`/sddc-lcm`, the path component of the specification's only server URL), then the operation's path template. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for the specification's `bearerToken` scheme and `Accept: application/json` on every request. Send `Content-Type: application/json` only on a request that carries an entity. `X-Correlation-Id` is an optional header parameter that the specification declares on `setDepot`, `createComponents` and `updateComponentConfig` only: send it on exactly those three operations and only when `Config.CorrelationID` is non-empty, and never send the header with an empty value. No operation used here declares a query parameter, so no request may carry a query string. Treat the specification's documented success status as the only success: 202 for `setDepot`, `createComponents` and `updateComponentConfig`, 200 for `resolveDepotComponents` and `getTask`.

`Apply` runs the plan in `PlanOperations` order. `setDepot` posts a `FleetDepotSpec` built from `Plan.Depot`. `resolveDepotComponents` posts a `DepotComponentsSpec` carrying that same depot as `fleetDepotSpec`, the optional `Plan.DepotVersion` as `version`, and `Plan.Pins` as `componentVersions`. `createComponents` posts a `ComponentSpecs` body whose `componentSpecs` entries are `OvaComponentSpec` documents built from `Plan.Components`, each node an `OvaNodeSpec` with a nested `repository` and `deploymentSpec`. When `Plan.Config` is non-nil, `updateComponentConfig` patches `/v1/components/{componentId}/config` for `Plan.Config.ComponentID` with an `OvaComponentConfigSpec` carrying `type` and `nodeSizes`.

Omit every unset optional member completely. An unset `Plan.DepotVersion`, `ComponentPin.Version`, `NodePlan.RepositoryCert`, `DeploymentOption`, `DNSSuffix`, `NetworkName`, `ExtraConfig`, `IPv4`, `IPv6` or `DeploymentMode`, and an unset `NodeSizePlan.NodeName`, `NodeType`, `NumCores`, `MemoryGB` or `ConfigMode`, must not appear in the request at all. Never serialize an unset option as an empty string, zero, false, `null`, an empty object or an empty array, and never emit a `configSpec` member that the plan does not populate. Preserve populated values exactly, including a pointer to an explicit `false` or numeric zero.

`setDepot`, `createComponents` and `updateComponentConfig` are accepted asynchronously and return a `Task`. Drive each accepted task to a terminal state with `getTask` on `/v1/tasks/{taskId}`, sending no body and no `Content-Type`. Poll immediately after acceptance and then wait `PollInterval` between polls; `PENDING`, `SCHEDULED` and `RUNNING` continue, and `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED` and `CANCELED` are terminal. Give up after `PollTimeout`. A `getTask` failure is attributed to the plan step that submitted the task, not to `getTask`.

`Apply` returns a `*PlanReport` that is never nil, even when the error is non-nil. `PlanReport.Steps` always holds exactly one `StepReport` per `PlanOperations` entry, in that order. A step that ran and succeeded is `SUCCEEDED` with an empty `Message`; a step whose operation returned a task also carries that task's id and terminal status, while `resolveDepotComponents` leaves `TaskID` and `TaskStatus` empty. A step rejected by a status code is `FAILED` with `HTTPStatus` set and `Message` taken from the `ErrorResponse` body's `message.defaultMessage`. A step whose task ended unsuccessfully is `FAILED` with `HTTPStatus` zero, the task id, the terminal task status, `FailedStage` set to the `name` of the failing `TaskStage`, and `Message` taken from that stage's `ERROR` level message `defaultMessage`. Steps after a failure are `SKIPPED` with `Message` exactly `skipped after <failed operationId> failed`. When `Plan.Config` is nil, `updateComponentConfig` is `SKIPPED` with `Message` exactly `skipped: plan requests no component configuration change` and the plan still succeeds. Earlier outcomes, including `PlanReport.ResolvedVersions` populated in submission order from the `resolveDepotComponents` reply, survive a later failure unchanged.

On failure `Apply` also returns a `*StepError` carrying the failing operationId and the same diagnosis, retrievable with `errors.As`. Never place a token, a raw response body or a transport error string in a `StepError` message.

Verify with `go test -race ./...`.
scenario: The fleet depot registers and the component versions resolve, then the createComponents task ends FAILED at its component-node-deploy stage, so the deployment step must be reported with that stage while the two completed steps keep their real outcomes and updateComponentConfig is reported as skipped.
constraint: The contract-pinned loopback request log proves the exact request sequence, the per-operation X-Correlation-Id rule, and the complete omission of every unset optional body member rather than an empty, zero or null one.
